project_type: MQL5 Expert Advisor with Python backtester reference implementation
build_system: MetaTrader 5 compiler (not available in sandbox) - validation via AST/syntax review only
test_framework: pytest for Python tests in tests/ directory; MQL5 has no automated test runner available
build_command: N/A - MQL5 compiler not available in sandbox
verification_instructions: Since MQL5 compiler is not available, verification is: 1) ensure the MQL5 code changes are syntactically valid MQL5, 2) run Python tests to confirm reference logic unchanged, 3) review diff for logical correctness against Python reference
setup_instructions: pip install pandas numpy pytest (already available for Python)
environment_constraints: MQL5 compiler (MetaEditor) not available in sandbox. Cannot compile or run the EA. All MQL5 changes must be validated by code review against Python reference. Network mode: repository access only.
contribution_requirements: Commit to main branch, do NOT push
key_patterns: The MQL5 EA (ICT_Bot.mq5) replicates the Python ICT bot logic. Key mapping: backtester.py run loop = CheckForNewBar/ProcessNewCandle, entry_model.py = state machine (g_state), market_structure.py = DetectSwingPoints/DetectMSS, liquidity.py = DetectEqualLevels/DetectLiquiditySweeps, fvg.py = DetectFVG, risk_management.py = CalculatePositionSize
directory_structure: ICT_Bot.mq5 (main MQL5 EA), ict_bot/ (Python modules: backtester, entry_model, market_structure, liquidity, fvg, etc.), tests/ (pytest tests), config/ (settings.yaml)
